children.value: Frequently Asked Questions
What pods are compatible with the Smok Novo Classy?
The Smok Novo Classy takes the
Smok Novo Meshed CLX Replacement Pod
, a magnetic side-fill pod with a built-in mesh coil in 0.6ohm or 0.8ohm. Smok also lists the top-fill Smok Novo SLR pod for this kit. Smok Novo 2, Novo 4, Novo 5 and Novo X pods are different pods.
How long should a Smok Novo pod last?
A
Smok Novo Meshed CLX Replacement Pod usually lasts one to two weeks

of normal use on 50/50 e-liquid or nic salts; sweet or thick liquids shorten that. Change it when flavour fades, a draw tastes burnt, or the pod gurgles after a refill. A three pack covers roughly three to six weeks.
Which is better, 0.6 or 0.8 ohm Smok Novo CLX pod?
Neither is better; they give different draws. The
0.6ohm Smok Novo Meshed CLX pod
is airier with more vapour and suits 50/50 liquid at lower nicotine. The
0.8ohm dual meshed pod
is tighter and more cigarette-like, uses less liquid and suits 10mg or 20mg nic salts. Ex-disposable users usually pick the 0.8ohm.
Do Smok Novo Meshed CLX Replacement Pods fit the Smok Novo 2?
No.
Smok Novo Meshed CLX Replacement Pods are made for the Smok Novo Classy
, which uses a magnetic pod. The Smok Novo 2, Novo 2S, Novo 2X, Novo 2C and Novo 3 use the friction-fit Smok Novo 2 Replacement Pod instead. Check the kit name on the device before ordering.
Why does my Smok Novo Meshed CLX pod taste burnt?
A burnt taste on a
new Smok Novo Meshed CLX pod almost always means the cotton was not soaked
before the first draw. Fill it, stand it for five to ten minutes, then take short gentle draws. On an older pod it means the mesh is spent: fit a fresh one. Avoid chain vaping.
